prompt: Use Tugling to add this feature, keep the diff small, and verify the real user flow.
Explain what this existing helper function returns without changing any files.
Fix the spelling error in this one sentence and leave everything else untouched.
Use Tugling to assess this repository and set up its project adapter and pinned CI contract.
I corrected a repeatable engineering decision; record a local Tugling lesson only if this project opted in and no private data is needed.
Create an implementation plan for migrating this endpoint without breaking current callers.
The design is settled; implement the named two-line fix and run the focused test.
Before coding, split this database change into safe rollout steps with rollback and proof.
Review this list API design for pagination, query count, latency, and cost at one million rows.
Change this empty-state sentence to be shorter without touching application behavior.
This daily job is cheap today; model its reads, retention, cleanup, and monthly cost at ten times the accounts.
Design this webhook consumer so duplicate, delayed, and out-of-order deliveries converge safely.
Add synchronous request validation for this form field and return a clear client error.
Two scheduler runs can overlap after a timeout; define the idempotency and recovery behavior.
Run the repository checks, fix failures caused by this diff, and tell me whether it is merge-ready.
Summarize the implementation approach from the code without running tests or changing anything.
CI reports a missing module that exists on my disk; diagnose the repository state and rerun the right gate.
This screen still looks off after several spacing tweaks; diagnose the screenshot before changing CSS.
Invent a new logo and color palette for a product that does not have an interface yet.
Fix the mobile overflow, compare the nearest product screen, and inspect desktop and narrow screenshots.
Create a reusable Codex skill for reviewing migrations and include routing cases and validation.
Rewrite this one-off prompt so it asks for a shorter summary; do not save it as a skill.
Revise the existing skill that over-triggers, preserve its good cases, and prove the holdouts do not regress.
